comment: AGOS Organizational Memory: policies the company has ADOPTED, each with its evidence and adoption date. This is institutional knowledge, when someone (or Aira) asks WHY we work a certain way, the answer lives here with receipts. Two statuses: 'adopted' (in force) and 'hypothesis' (believed, evidence still accumulating; the Learning Engine promotes hypotheses only when measured evidence crosses threshold, and adoption itself is a founder call).

policies.statement: No em-dashes in any AEGIBIT artifact.
evidence: Founder directive after brand review of the company profile PDF; enforced by CI guard and AGOS DNA.

policies.statement: The business phone number never appears on the public website; contact routes through /contact and email.
evidence: Founder privacy directive; phone stays on GBP, PDFs, proposals, signatures.

policies.statement: All outward publishing (social, email, external posts) is drafted by AGOS and sent by the founder.
evidence: Access governance rules 4; encoded in DNA securityStandard and the no-autopost policy gate.

policies.statement: Reference-grade pages (glossary, definitions, comparisons) are prioritized over generic blog posts for GEO authority.
evidence: Industry-consensus reasoning encoded in the authority evaluator (+8 reference-grade bonus). NO first-party measurement yet: awaiting GSC outcome data on our own glossary rollout before this can be promoted to adopted.

policies.statement: Every knowledge surface (Aira chat, llms.txt, future docs) generates from one crawled index, never hand-maintained copies.
evidence: Prevented the stale-prompt failure mode that shipped a retired product (VoiceCore) in the chat widget for weeks.
